# Mary Says Yes to God (Luke 1:38)

## Emotional Focus
Saying “yes” to God with a trusting heart.

## Key KJV
“Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.” (Luke 1:38)

## Gentle Retelling
An angel told Mary she would be the mother of baby Jesus. Mary listened and said, “I am the Lord’s servant. Let it happen just as You say.”

## Coloring Prompt
Mary kneeling peacefully as the angel speaks to her with soft light.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“We can say yes to God just like Mary did.”
